points.love: These items are guaranteed to give the most points (80) towards your relationship, but may be difficult to obtain.
points.like: a liked gift increases friendship by 45 points (just over half that of a loved gift) and is often much easier to obtain.
points.neutral: This is a list of items that will elicit a neutral response from the villagers, and give 20 points toward friendship.
points.dislike: This is a list of items that will decrease friendship by 20 points when given as gifts.
points.hate: This is a list of items that will decrease friendship by 40 points when given as gifts.

evidence.multipliers: The friendship points are multiplied on their birthday (×8) and Feast of the Winter Star secret gifting event (×5), as well as after reading Friendship 101 (x1.1):
evidence.birthday: Gifts on {{#switch:{{#invoke:NPCDispositions|getgender|{{PAGENAME}}}} |female = her |male = his |#default = their}} birthday ({{Season |{{#invoke:NPCDispositions|getbirthseason|{{PAGENAME}}}} |{{#invoke:NPCDispositions|getbirthday|{{PAGENAME}}}} }}) will have 8× effect and show a unique dialogue.
evidence.winter_star: The gift the player selects for their villager will be worth 5x the normal amount of friendship points.
evidence.friendship_101: The first reading grants the player a power that increases any friendship gained by 10%. Friendship decreases are unaffected.
evidence.quality: If a gift is liked or loved, the points gained will be further affected by the quality of the item:
evidence.equation: For liked or loved gifts, the equation is Event Multiplier × Preference × Quality Multiplier, where Event Multiplier is 1 (any day), 5 (the player's Winter Star recipient), or 8 (their birthday), Preference is 80 (loved gifts) or 45 (liked gifts), and Quality Multiplier is 1, 1. Quality Multiplier is 1, 1.1, 1.25, or 1.5.
evidence.max_single_gift: The highest friendship points possible from a single gift would be to gift someone an iridium-quality loved gift on their birthday, which would yield 960 points, just short of 4 hearts.
evidence.stardrop_tea: Stardrop Tea can be gifted for 250 friendship points (1 heart).
